snippet.title: Better Than Us Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing the next title from the award-winning creators of Vampire Therapist. In this new type of social stealth game, you'll have to remember all the lies you tell to the richest people on earth. Past and present become the future in this dark comedy tale of extreme wealth, coming in 2026!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3954390/Better_Than_Us/
